ingameEffects.label: Disco Demon (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: The equipper's Anomaly Proficiency is increased. When the equipper's EX Special Attack or Basic Attack deals Ether DMG, all squad members' DMG dealt is increased for 40s, stacking up to 2 times. This effect can trigger once per use of a skill and repeated triggers reset the duration. With 2 stacks, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency is further increased. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
